contract: Read each complete AVC/AAC HLS segment and all five progressive TS188 inputs through a TS PES feed. Drive each standalone AVC and AAC assembler through push_compact and drain both at EOF.

The reference reads the same forward windows with the TS demuxer and the stock AVC and AAC parsers. Fold all units in per-lane order, video first, including the AVC source Annex B bytes, PES times, IDR and raster, and AAC frame bytes with exact duration.

Each operation constructs the feed and assemblers, processes and releases the complete input, retains units through drain and folds them. Input loading is outside the operation. Refusal is a single kind 8 record.

open_deviations.reading: A legal duplicate transport packet carries no new payload
open_deviations.clause: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §2.4.3.3 permits two consecutive same-PID packets with one continuity_counter and adaptation_field_control 01 or 11 when their bytes match apart from a valid PCR.
open_deviations.candidate: Returns 36 compact-input AAC and AVC access-unit records with 5573 source bytes, matching the nonduplicated control.
open_deviations.reference: Reports a PES size mismatch, marks the AAC packet corrupt and ends with a refusal record.

open_refusals.reason: The standalone compact AVC assembler refuses a stream whose first access unit has no access unit delimiter; the segment and progressive views of the same input accept it
open_refusals.clause: ITU-T H.222.0 (08/2023) §2.14.1 requires an access unit delimiter in every AVC access unit; ITU-T H.264 (08/2024) §7.4.1.2.3 places it first
open_refusals.detail: AVC TS access unit has no initial delimiter
